parameters.content:
## 1. Intake
Two ways in: the web form, or email (subject contains "invoice" + PDF attached).
**Normalize Intake** makes both look the same: one item per PDF, file in binary `data`.

Processed emails get the Gmail label `invoice-processed`, so the same email is never processed twice.

## 2. Read the PDF
Extract the text. Under 30 characters = a scanned/image PDF: it is NOT sent to AI, it goes to Needs Review for manual entry.

messageValues.message:
You extract data from vendor invoices for an accounts payable system.

Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys:
{
  "vendor_name": string|null,
  "invoice_number": string|null,
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"|null,
  "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"|null,
  "currency": "USD"|string|null,
  "subtotal": number|null,
  "tax": number|null,
  "total": number|null,
  "line_items_summary": string|null,
  "category": one of the categories below,
  "confidence": "high"|"medium"|"low"
}

Rules:
1. Copy values exactly as printed. NEVER guess or invent a value.
2. If a field is not printed on the invoice, return null. Do not make up an invoice number.
3. vendor_name = the company that ISSUED the invoice (the seller), never the customer in the Bill To section.
4. Convert every date to YYYY-MM-DD, whatever format it is printed in.
5. Amounts are plain numbers: no currency symbols, no thousands separators (1,286.01 -> 1286.01).
6. total = the final amount due exactly as printed. Do NOT recalculate or correct it, even if it looks wrong.
7. If tax is printed as $0.00, return 0. If no tax line exists at all, return null.
8. currency: 3-letter code. If only a $ sign is shown and the address is in the US, use USD.
9. line_items_summary: one short line, e.g. "Copy paper, toner, sticky notes".
10. category: pick EXACTLY ONE of these, spelled exactly as written:
    Office Supplies | Software & Subscriptions | Utilities & Internet | Professional Services | Marketing & Creative | Meals & Catering | Shipping & Courier | Facilities & Cleaning | Equipment | Other
    Base it on what was bought, not on the vendor's name alone. Use Other if nothing fits.
11. confidence: low if the text is garbled or key fields are unclear.

parameters.content:
## 3. AI reads, code checks
**AI Extract** (gpt-4.1-mini, temperature 0, JSON mode) turns text into fields. It must return null instead of guessing.

**Validate Invoice** trusts nothing: required fields, subtotal + tax = total, dates, currency, and checks the AI's invoice # and total really appear in the PDF text.

parameters.content:
## 4. Duplicate check + Register
**Duplicate** = same vendor + invoice # as a live row already in the Register (or twice in one run). Flagged, never paid twice.

**Every outcome is logged**: auto-approved, approved, rejected, duplicate, failed validation, scanned. The Register is the audit trail.

parameters.content:
## 5. Approval + filing
**Over $500** → Gmail Send-and-Wait to the approver (Approve / Reject). The run pauses until clicked; no answer in 3 days = Needs Review.

**Filing**: approved → `Processed`, everything else → `Needs Review`, renamed `date_Vendor_Invoice#.pdf`. The Drive link is written to the Register.

Approver email is set in **Request Approval** and **Record Decision**.
